title: Frontend Core
description: Smoke coverage for implemented black-cat frontend pages.

tests.title: Home, leaderboard, and master pages render without client/runtime crashes.
tests.description: This smoke test verifies the three primary routes can be loaded in a deterministic local run. It catches route-level breakage and hydration issues.
steps: Open /master and verify no runtime exception
tests.successCriteria: All three pages render and remain interactive with no visible error boundary.

tests.title: Subscribe page accepts deterministic input interactions and does not throw UI errors.
tests.description: This test validates the subscription page interaction path at UI level. It guards against form and component regressions.
steps: Enter deterministic form values if fields are present
Trigger submit action and assert stable UI state
tests.successCriteria: Subscribe page handles interaction without crash and shows expected success/pending UI state.

tests.title: Cross-page navigation from home to subscribe and back remains stable under repeated transitions.
tests.description: This deep browser test validates a realistic multi-page user journey instead of isolated page checks. It catches accumulated client-state or routing issues that only appear after several transitions.
steps: Return to / and verify UI remains interactive
tests.successCriteria: All transitions complete without runtime errors and final page remains interactive.
